submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Create one opaque native 1254 by 1254 game-map patch r04_c01 for the original Daoist chibi game 五行奇谈. Use exactly Image 1 framing, scale, silhouettes and coordinates.
PRIORITY WATER MATERIAL: the water must have the same quiet, broad, flat painted blue shapes as the lower-middle interior and the left 230-pixel native strip of Image 1. Large overlapping blue and turquoise brush planes, each tens to hundreds of pixels wide, restrained contrast, very few broad lighter strokes. Preserve these broad shapes and their scale. Clear native rendering means clean silhouette edges and smooth painted surfaces, NOT extra surface detail. Do not add thin bright reflection lines, white vein networks, caustic meshes, lattices, webbing, sparkling points, tiny ripples, repeating scales, photographic refraction, busy texture or an increased number of wave shapes. Do not turn the plain central/lower water into a patterned carpet.
COMPOSITION LOCK: turquoise and deep blue water fills nearly the whole square. Keep the same rounded green foliage patch in the upper-left beneath its existing water tint, the same tiny clipped foliage at the bottom-right, and only the existing narrow blue-grey stone bridge-arch wedge clipped at the upper-right. Keep those precise envelopes, leaf locations, shadow areas and colors. No land, islands, new foliage, trees, structures, extra stones or objects. Retain the foliage character; do not add luminous water lines across the leaves.
NATIVE EDGE LOCK: Image 1 contains real adjacent-image context in its first 230 pixels on the left and top. Keep those existing native boundary shapes, colors and endpoints fixed. Resolve the remaining soft guide interior at that same mapping. At x=230/y=230 remove only guide-paste discontinuity by naturally continuing the existing scene; do not create a line, stripe, rectangular patch or false physical edge. Do not spread any tiny highlights that already occur in the north context across the quiet central and southern water. Preserve framing: no zoom, pan, rotation, stretching, object movement or redesign.
STYLE: Image 2 is the user-confirmed PRIMARY painting/material reference: bright clean rounded full-bodied Daoist chibi, subtle hand-painted volume, simple polished surfaces, quiet and readable. It is a material/style reference only: copy no UI, text, borders or decoration. Match Image 1 colors and composition. No photorealism, plastic rendering, noise, blur, sharpening halos, text or watermark. Return only the single 1254-square native patch, clean broad water shapes throughout the newly painted interior.
